partners.mechanism_chain: ABCA5 (HGNC:24086) —LEADS_TO→ Gingival fibromatosis (HP:0000212); PEX3 (HGNC:9277) —DISRUPTS→ Peroxisomal protein import (GO:0001424); Peroxisomal protein import (GO:0001424) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal peroxisome morphology (HP:0011221); Peroxisomal protein import (GO:0001424) —LEADS_TO→ Intellectual disability (HP:0001249). Loss-of-function mutations in ABCA5 lead to gingival fibromatosis (Disease A). Concurrently, loss-of-function mutations in PEX3 disrupt peroxisomal protein import, leading to abnormal peroxisome morphology and intellectual disability (Disease B). partners.mechanism_chain: ABCG8 (HGNC:2) —DISRUPTS→ Cholesterol homeostasis and transport (REACT:R-HSA-71403); Cholesterol homeostasis and transport (REACT:R-HSA-71403) —DECREASES→ Plant Sterols (e.g., Sitosterol) (CHEBI:27790); Plant Sterols (e.g., Sitosterol) (CHEBI:27790) —LEADS_TO→ Xanthoma (HP:0003279); ABCA5 (HGNC:1) —DISRUPTS→ Cholesterol homeostasis and transport (REACT:R-HSA-71403); Cholesterol homeostasis and transport (REACT:R-HSA-71403) —LEADS_TO→ Fibrotic tissue overgrowth (HP:0001370); Cholesterol homeostasis and transport (REACT:R-HSA-71403) —LEADS_TO→ Hypertrichosis (HP:0000956). **How to falsify it:** If mutations in ABCA5 are found to be common in patients with hereditary systemic amyloidosis 3, or if mutations in APOA1 are found to be common in patients with gingival fibromatosis-hypertrichosis syndrome, and these mutations do not lead to the proposed functional consequences (loss-of-function), this hypothesis would be falsified. Additionally, if a clear mechanistic link between ABCA5 dysfunction and amyloid precursor protein processing, or between APOA1 dysfunction and extracellular matrix deposition in the gums, cannot be established, the hypothesis would be weakened. _(variant: The presence of common loss-of-function variants in ABCA5 (for disease A) or APOA1 (for disease B) in the general population (e.g., gnomAD allele frequency > 1%) would challenge their role as rare disease-causing genes.)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding this mechanistic link could reveal novel therapeutic targets for both gingival fibromatosis and hereditary systemic amyloidosis. Modulating cholesterol metabolism or protein processing pathways affected by ABCA5 and APOA1 dysfunction might offer a unified therapeutic strategy or at least provide insights into parallel therapeutic approaches for these distinct rare diseases.
